what: Letter Keeper map figure; faithful A1 identity
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: Letter Keeper full-body map figure for Time Capsule, 1024 square RGBA.
Input references: Image 1 is design/art/style-sheet.png: match this approved style exactly. Image 2 is the Roy-selected A1 NPC sketch from codex/character-profile-options. Match the SAME MAN and the SAME OUTFIT faithfully; do not redesign him.
Subject identity: friendly middle-aged man, warm medium skin, short dark hair with some grey, same soft face shape and gentle smile as A1. Ink-blue short-brim cap, no emblem; short navy collared jacket over a cream shirt; navy trousers; simple brown walking shoes; small cream cross-body letter satchel at his hip. No new accessories.
FULL BODY: one complete standing person, normal illustrated head on his neck, torso, both arms down with complete hands, two separate legs, BOTH COMPLETE SHOES including soles. Never crop any body part. Do NOT create a bust, portrait disc, photo window, circular head background, pedestal, pin, ground shadow, map or scenery.
Pose: upright and relaxed, arms down, body turned slightly toward the VIEWER'S RIGHT (his left), nose and toe tips subtly pointing toward image right. Front three-quarter view, camera slightly elevated to see shoulder/shoe tops, as a billboard sprite on a map tilted 40 degrees. Keep his pose usable as the same canonical facing as the player figures; the app will mirror it.
Scale: same gentle adult storybook proportions as A1, about four head-heights, not caricature/chibi. In the 1024 square, ordinary head-top around y=180, soles at y=900; the cap may rise slightly above the head-top. Roughly 720 px adult head-to-soles. Center the complete figure around x=512. Generous fully transparent padding all around.
Portrait-weight clean plum/navy lines, flat fills plus one soft shadow tone, no hatching on the face. Must read at 64–120 px tall. Use the natural human skin and hair treatment established by the selected A1.
App: 時光膠囊 / Time Capsule. People send a sealed letter that can only be opened at a set time and place. Mood: tender, human, nostalgic, "precious in the AI age". Hand-inked storybook, not glossy 3D.
- Clean ink line art with a slightly hand-drawn line, flat colour fills plus one soft shading tone, a little paper grain, light hatching only (it must still read at about 120 px). Lines in plum #6E2B3F or navy #16263F.
- Palette only: ink blue #2F5D8A, light blue #5A8FD0, glass blue #DCE8F2, plum #6E2B3F, brass #C9A15A, wax red #A3364F, navy #16263F, paper #F6F8FB, cream #F3E2BB. Warm brown wood is allowed for wooden objects.
- Front three-quarter view, soft top-left light. No text, letters, numbers, logos or real brands.
- Transparent background, object centred, generous padding (object fills about 70% of the canvas), square.
Match the attached style sheet exactly.
postprocess: normalize-city-hunt-figures.py: remove isolated alpha <=8; one shared canonical scale 0.6715063520871143 for every figure, no per-figure fit; translate x centre to512 and projected soles to900 +/-4; no upscale. Mirrored to canonical viewer-right facing.
